_doc: Vei's final test (MECHANICS 6, GAMEPLAY 3d), read by VeiFronts (scripts/raid/vei_fronts.gd). Placeholders until calibrated. fronts_required of the four fronts must clear. fronts.<id>: have = per_stat * sum(stat of big undead counted on the front) + per_backlog * backlog + per_q * digest_q; need = need_base + need_per_pool * Vei's living pool; cleared = have >= need. phase1: ref_s = seconds to clear a front at have == need; max_rate caps have/need; phase1_max_s is the timeout (lost). raise_have_per_mult: what one raised undead adds to a front's have in phase 1, per stat_mult. ferry (phase 2): base + per_pool*living_pool + per_uncleared*uncleared (mass/s), divided by (1 + per_q_div*(q-1)). mote_mass = value of one raised mote toward the raise rate; raise_ema_beats = smoothing window of the raise rate in tempo beats. Vei breaks after break_beats consecutive beats with raise > ferry. loss_backlog_keep = share of the backlog kept on a loss. The blocks below fronts are the boss scene's (scripts/raid/vei_boss.gd, BossLogic, BossLanes, RaidVei); each has its own _doc.

phase1._doc: mote_rate: essence motes (fresh, mass 0) per second dropped by the fallen at each contested lane's front (uncleared lanes), within mote_spread_px of where the stream meets the guard line.

arena._doc: The boss arena: layout_logic.gen_layout(is_boss) with these layout keys merged over raid.json layout (rooms 1 = no partitions: the lanes cross open ground). The camera fits the whole arena (zoom clamped to zoom_min..zoom_max, margin_px of ground round it).

court._doc: Vei's court: her centre sits y_px below the north wall; radius_px is her glyph (the largest on the field), rings x strokes its cream and gold rings.

lanes._doc: One lane per front, FRONT_IDS order west to east. Each runs from x_frac of the arena width, south_margin_px above the south wall, to a point court_r_px from Vei, spread over court_arc_deg. The guard line sits at lane fraction guard_s0 at progress 0 and is pushed to guard_s1 as the front's progress reaches 1. Streams: glyphs_per_have undead glyphs per point of have (glyphs_min..glyphs_max), marching march_px_s, spread across band_px. Guard line: rows_per_need rows of living per point of need (1..rows_max), guards_across wide, row_px apart. A cleared front's guard line breaks over break_s. glyph_r_px sizes the stream glyphs. Phase-1 raised undead run into their lane at runner_px_s. label_px is the label size on screen.

anchors._doc: Phase 2: count anchor sigils where the ferried fall, between the lanes at lane fraction lane_s. Motes (fresh, mass 0) spawn at them at motes_per_ferry per unit of ferry rate (mass/s), split evenly, within spread_px. radius_px sizes the sigil.

guards._doc: Phase 2: each uncleared lane sends living guards at rate_per_uncleared per second (cap alive in all); they hunt Relish, and fight an undead within block_px of them (one in the way). motes_on_death: fresh motes a fallen guard drops. unit: the guard's statline.

weaves._doc: Phase 2: a weave every period_beats tempo beats from first_beat: a danger thread laid tell_beats ahead from Vei across Relish's position (the first weave's tell is first_tell_beats), width_px wide; on the beat it lands and Relish on it takes dmg (through the sacrifice chain). flash_s: the landing flash.

raised._doc: Phase-2 raised undead fight: engage_px is how far they look for a guard; unit_cap bounds how many stand at once (a raise past it still counts toward the break).

backups._doc: A Relish death spends a phylactery, then a ready clone (VeiFronts.next_backup); either revives her in place at revive_hp_frac of her hp with iframes_s of i-frames, under the crack set piece (crack_radius_px, crack_s). Each spent backup leaves a cracked violet ring on her, mark_radius_px + mark_step_px per ring.

end._doc: The closing set pieces, real seconds. Victory: her rings unravel over unravel_s, then every lane runs green toward her for green_s and freezes, held hold_s. Loss: the lanes drain into her over drain_s and dim, held lose_hold_s. Reduced motion scales them by rm_scale.

demo._doc: The standalone boss seed (STATE-API 7.2; Results.validate boss_seed). Its fronts are zero, like economy's seed before E3, so the scene computes them (3 of 4 met with the numbers above: raw is short). --boss-fronts=n forces the first n fronts met at force_met_frac of need and the rest at force_unmet_frac.

autopilot._doc: DEV: the boss bot (scripts/raid/boss_autopilot.gd). Same circle approach as raid.json autopilot: a trace_points circle round the motes within raise_reach_px, jitter binary-searched to land within score_tol of the target. dodge: chance to sidestep a weave tell; cluster_px: how near motes count as one cluster.

dev._doc: DEV: --boss-stress tops the guards up to the cap and spawns stress_raised raised undead and stress_motes motes at the anchors when the break begins.
